{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
# But we already saw no commas — just verify
if df['revenue'].str.contains(',').any():
    df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    print('Commas removed from revenue.')
else:
    print('No commas found in revenue column.')

# Now safely cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].astype(float)

# Confirm the change
print('\nRevenue dtype after cleaning:', df['revenue'].dtype)
print('\nFirst few cleaned revenue values:')
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Now compute mean age, excluding -1 values (missing data)
valid_age = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']
mean_age = valid_age.mean()

print('\nMean age of customers (excluding -1 values):', mean_age)"}
